text:
Last night I touched you and felt you
without my hand fleeing beyond my hand,
without my body fleeing, or my ear;
I felt you in a nearly human way.

Pulsing,
I cannot tell whether like blood or a wandering cloud,
through my house, on tiptoe, darkness rising,
darkness falling, you ran, flashing.

You ran through my wooden house,
opened its windows,
and I felt you beat the whole night through,
daughter of the abysses, silent,
warrior, so terrible, so beautiful
that everything that exists,
for me, without your flame, would not exist.

translation.title: Last Night I Touched You and Felt You...
